description: A React functional component named SCIMConfig that provides a UI for configuring System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM). It allows users to view SCIM URLs, generate and copy SCIM tokens, and manages state related to token creation and display.

methods.name: SCIMConfig
methods.description: React functional component for managing and displaying SCIM configuration and tokens.

methods.name: handleCreateSCIMToken
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new SCIM token via an API call, updates state, and manages notifications.
